name: application-menubar
title: Menubar
description: Horizontal application menu bar (File/Edit/View style) where each top-level label opens a dropdown of menu items, with full keyboard navigation between menus.
useWhen: Building a desktop-style application shell with top-level menus like File, Edit, View, Help.
You need several related dropdown menus that share one horizontal bar and keyboard-navigate between each other.
Menu items benefit from paired keyboard-shortcut hints and disabled/separator rows.
avoidWhen: You only need a single dropdown off one trigger — use the simpler Dropdown component instead.
The navigation represents site sections rather than commands — use Navigation Menu or Vertical Menu instead.
responsiveBehavior: The bar is a single-row inline-flex; on narrow viewports collapse it into a single trigger (e.g. a hamburger) rather than wrapping menu labels.
accessibility: Each top-level trigger carries aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded reflecting open state.
Open menus use role="menu" with role="menuitem" children so assistive technology announces the menu semantics.
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus between top-level menus, matching the WAI-ARIA menubar pattern; Escape closes the open menu and returns focus to its trigger.
Disabled items carry the disabled attribute so they are skipped by keyboard interaction and announced as unavailable.

variants.title: Menubar
variants.description: A four-item menu bar (File, Edit, View, Help) with the File menu open, showing shortcut-hint items, a separator, and a disabled item.
accessibility: Keyboard users can move between File/Edit/View/Help with the arrow keys once any menu has focus.

variants.title: Menubar (Dark)
variants.description: The same four-item menu bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Open-menu and hover states remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
